maps.visual_map_v3: Bug fix only: decoded ordinal i paired with odometry/depth row i+1 (verified by timestamp fingerprint at build time). Same RGB reference images as v2 (ordinals 0, 90, ...). Retrieval, features, matcher, and acceptance unchanged.
maps.visual_map_v4_low_rotation: v3 association plus one design change motivated by the audit: within each 90-frame window choose the frame with the lowest recorded turning speed. Retrieval, features, matcher, and acceptance unchanged.

B.role: held out from the audit; reported as the primary same-recording comparison

comparisons: v3 vs v2 on A isolates the association fix on the audited images
v3 vs v4 on B tests low-rotation reference selection on unaudited images
limits: Set B is evaluated with two map variants; no further variants may be tuned on B. A new held-out set (ideally independent phone photos) is required for any later change.
Same-recording queries are not independent-phone validation; recorded poses are internal comparisons, not surveyed truth.
